extraction_quality_notes: Ranking observations were limited to demographics, risk context, recurrent presentation history, admission symptoms, early neurologic findings, vital-sign/ECG findings, early labs, urine culture, early biochemical screen, and pre-confirmation imaging/endoscopy findings.
No expected-manifold label, final diagnosis field, paper disease-label field, or paper-title-derived diagnosis evidence is included.
All rankable clinical facts use diagnosis-neutral generic axis IDs; no ordinary observed axis uses a disease-specific disease_id suffix.
The qualitative urine PBG screen is included as an objective early workup lab. The day-6 quantitative PBG confirmation is record-only because it is later confirmatory course.
SIADH is retained only as an interpretation in record_only; plasma osmolality, urine osmolality, and urine sodium are the rankable objective facts.

No exact body temperature, respiratory rate, oxygen saturation, numeric blood pressure, CBC count values, CRP value, creatinine, BUN, AST/ALT, bilirubin, cortisol, TSH, urinalysis details, or pain score is reported.
Hypertension is reported without a numeric blood pressure.
Sodium 114 mmol/L occurred after IV normal saline but before definitive diagnosis-specific treatment; it is marked with temporal context.
disease_label_per_paper: Acute intermittent porphyria with SIADH and neuropathy
